population.source: WorldPop Global 2000-2020 population grid, 1 km aggregated
population.method: area-weighted sum of 1 km source cells into the 0.1 degree grid, computed in degrees
population.note: Modelled population, not a census. Not the population on the day of a fire.

infrastructure.hospitals_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: amenity=hospital (counted); clinic and doctors, healthcare=clinic (counted apart)
infrastructure.roads_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: highway=motorway|trunk|primary, ways with a name or ref, merged by name and class
infrastructure.scope: Only facilities and roads inside a 0.1 degree cell that has had fire since 2000 are kept, so a distance to fire is 0 by construction.
infrastructure.schools_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: amenity=school|kindergarten (all counted per cell; named ones listed)

caveat: Population and infrastructure inside cells where the harmonized record shows fire. A context layer, not an impact estimate: FIRMS gives detections, not a fire perimeter, and there is no smoke or fire-spread model here.

farmland.source: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, class 40 (Cropland), read at the ~74 m overview
farmland.method: share of cropland pixels in each 0.1 degree cell times the cell area (cosine of latitude)
farmland.note: Land cover from one year, not what was planted the month of a fire. Fire on farmland is often residue burning by the farmers themselves; detections are not burned area, so nothing here says crops were lost.
